memory_bridge: A new pupil retrieves On ニュウ. For the native pair, the person goes in with 入る（はいる）; the hand puts an object in with 入れる（いれる）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 入学（にゅうがく）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A new pupil funnels through the school doorway: ‘new entry’ cues ニュウ in 入学（にゅうがく）, entering school.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 入る（はいる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The child walks through the narrowing strokes under their own power: 入る（はいる）, ‘to enter.’

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 入れる（いれる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Now the child picks up a book and puts it through the doorway: 入れる（いれる）, ‘to put in.’
